# Feature: Initiative 3D W6 (who starts)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-07-17 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Before the match crash/arena intro continues, clicking **Letz Fetz** rolls two W6 (human vs bot) with a CSS 3D die animation. Higher roll starts; ties re-roll. Engine `createGame` uses that `startingPlayer`.

## Preconditions
- Solo bot match started from GameSetup (characters chosen)
- MatchIntro is open; opening deal has not finished yet

## Happy Path
- [ ] Clicking Letz Fetz on MatchIntro enters initiative phase with two 3D W6
- [ ] After animation, higher roll becomes `startingPlayer`; UI shows who starts
- [ ] Game state is (re)created with that starter before crash/arena/deal
- [ ] Flow continues crash → arena → continue as today
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion`: instant reveal, no tumble

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Tie → message + automatic re-roll (same phase)
- [ ] Dice values always 1–6 from engine `rollD6`

## Regression
- [ ] Opening deal still runs after intro closes
- [ ] CombatDiceRoll / LLM bot toggle unchanged

## Assumptions
- CSS 3D (no new deps); dice are presentation of engine rolls
- Temporary createGame before initiative may be replaced with same seed + resolved starter
